key_insight: ClinVerse moves medical AI training and evaluation beyond static questions into interactive diagnostic scenarios with feedback on the full decision-making process.
clinical_relevance: The environment tests how agents gather patient information, request examinations, and reach diagnoses, but does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Grounds simulated interactions in ClinPatient, a dataset of 150,000 diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records.
Coordinates six specialized clinical roles as a doctor agent interviews patients, requests examinations, and produces a diagnosis.
Uses rule-based trajectory scores for information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy to support training and evaluation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations of general-purpose and medical-domain models, with nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improving diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse.
watch_item: Improvements within a scored simulation may not translate to safe, effective care; the abstract reports no prospective clinical validation.
paper_title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
